build(studio): scripted macOS release app with bundled native proofing libraries

tool/build_macos_app.sh builds the pinned Hunspell, Arabic morphology,
CLD3 language-ID and Harper libraries, runs flutter build macos --release,
installs the receipt-verified libraries into Contents/Frameworks and their
notices into Contents/Resources, normalizes Harper's install name to @rpath,
re-signs ad hoc with Release.entitlements and verifies the signature, the
load commands and that each library opens from the bundle.

test/studio_macos_bundle_native_gate.dart (explicit gate, not auto-discovered)
boots Studio with the in-bundle libraries and data installed by the real
installers and checks a mixed Arabic/German/English document: Arabic rules,
AyaSpell, morphology rules (jussive, numeral gender), German spelling routed
by detection, Harper, the Detected display and Apply detected language.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
